name: Griblje - Wikipedija, prosta enciklopedija
snippet: Griblje so večje naselje v Beli krajini. Ležijo med reko Kolpo in cesto Podzemelj - Krasinec - Dragoši - Fučkovci - Dolenjci - Adlešiči - Preloka - Vinica.

name: Pond in Griblje
snippet: This small, but beautiful, pond is not well known, except to locals. It lies in the fields between the villages of Griblje and Krasinec .
